finding: No false positive benchmark has been run. The scam detection engine v3.0 was tested with 3 samples (recovery scam CRITICAL 1.0, romance scam CRITICAL 0.79, clean text MINIMAL 0.0) during development, but no systematic ground-truth benchmark exists. This is a CRITICAL GAP — without measuring false positives, we cannot claim the system is reliable.
